name: rtl433-app
description: Capacitor mobile shell for the rtl_433 dashboard

scripts.build:android: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:ios: cap sync ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -configuration Debug CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
